access.authentication: Official USDⓈ-M market-data route is documented as public market data; client sends no API key or Authorization header.
access.payment: No payment or account flow used. Official route docs describe IP request weight but do not grant redistribution rights.
access.policy: Read-only internal research candidate. No redistribution or commercial-use rights are claimed; confirm applicable Binance terms before broader use or publishing retained values.

supported_routes.task: historical open-interest statistics for one exact USDⓈ-M futures symbol
supported_routes.identity: Each returned symbol must exactly equal the requested uppercase symbol.
supported_routes.bounds: One request per command, one exact symbol, one documented interval, local limit 1–100 (official maximum 500), 10-second timeout, 500KB response ceiling, 30-second in-process cache, no retries. Official endpoint coverage is latest 30 days only.
supported_routes.timestamps: Provider timestamp is the end time of the period in Unix milliseconds; normalized UTC is retained alongside the original integer.
supported_routes.units: Provider describes sumOpenInterest as total open interest and sumOpenInterestValue as total open-interest value. Do not infer contract or quote denomination not specified in the route schema; raw strings are preserved.
supported_routes.freshness: Latest row is checked against retrieval time; marked STALE when older than max(two periods, one minute). Historical rows are not removed.

runtime_evidence.reason: region restriction from the current environment
runtime_evidence.retrieval_time: not captured exactly; completion observed no later than 2026-10-17T15:34:36Z

request_policy.retry_policy: No retries; stop on 401/402/403/404/429/451, timeout, malformed response, or identity mismatch.
request_policy.upstream_independence: First-party Binance USDⓈ-M venue observations. Distinct from Hyperliquid and DeFiLlama aggregate context; not a market-wide series.
request_policy.fallback: Do not replace a missing Binance USDⓈ-M history series with Hyperliquid data or DeFiLlama aggregate OI. Preserve venue and contract identity.
